name: unslop
description: Edit prose to remove AI-sounding language while preserving the writer's meaning and tone.

interface.longDescription: Edits user-provided prose to remove AI-sounding phrasing, filler, jargon, and mannered style while preserving its meaning and intended tone. Use it for editing, rewriting, polishing, or making prose sound less AI-written. It does not apply to code, verbatim quotations, or text the user explicitly asks to preserve unchanged.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $unslop to make this prose clearer and less AI-written: [paste text]
